screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.arc_leap_: Combines the normalized look vector with an upward component to cross gaps.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.recoil_hi: Applies the opposite of your look vector for a short immediate retreat.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.ore_centr: Finds blocks in #c:ores within radius 5 and marks their mean position.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.life_cent: Calculates and marks the mean center of nearby living creatures, excluding players.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.hostile_l: Selects nearby hostile creatures and applies an upward impulse to the set.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.vector_wa: Projects up to six creatures along your look direction using one effect plan.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.horizon_w: Prioritizes the farthest hostiles in the detected set and briefly lifts them.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.right_ang: Transforms a local right-axis vector through your horizontal frame for a pitch-independent sidestep.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.planar_da: Uses your local forward axis for a level dash even while looking sharply up or down.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.oblique_l: Combines local left, up, and forward components into a diagonal evasive leap.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.harmonic_: Evaluates sine and cosine at pi/4, then interprets the pair as local polar components.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.orthogona: Uses the cross product of up and look to construct a perpendicular sidestep.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.quarter_t: Lets the element 1 of C4 act on your look vector as a quarter-turn rotation.
screen.mathmod.rune_programmer.quadratur: Approximates the integral of sine on 0..pi/2 with Simpson's rule and turns half the area into lift.
